lines.en: Radon water doesn't bother me.
The stone halls have worn my soles flat.

lines.zh: 石像守卫今天也站得笔直。
lines.en: The stone sentries stand straight today too.

lines.zh: 壁垒的门锁着，我照旧巡。
lines.en: The bulwark's locked; I still patrol.

lines.zh: 天黑了，地牢里的东西会动。
lines.en: Dark's coming — things stir in the dungeon.
Why is the dungeon gate open?
Grain prices at the dungeon mouth rose again.
Not enough lead to patch the armor.
My legs are killing me.

lines.zh: 这条氡气弥漫的走廊，我最熟。
lines.en: I know this radon-filled corridor best.

lines.zh: 巡了半座地牢，一个人影也没有。
lines.en: Half the dungeon patrolled, not a soul.

lines.zh: 我得找 Radon Sentinel 谈笔生意。
lines.en: I must talk business with Radon Sentinel.

lines.zh: 壁垒地牢的钟，谁又敲响了？
lines.en: Who rang the bell in the Bulwark again?

lines.zh: 我沿着壁垒的走廊巡一圈。
lines.en: I walk one round of the bulwark's halls.
The dungeon is unnaturally quiet.
Guard duty weighs my eyelids down.

lines.zh: 我该去洗掉身上的氡尘了。
lines.en: I should wash the radon dust off.

lines.zh: 那个总来偷裂隙水晶的贼。
lines.en: That thief who keeps stealing rift crystals.

lines.zh: 该给 紫色粒子 上点油了。
lines.en: My purple particles needs some oil.

lines.zh: 壁垒地牢的门，我守了太久。
lines.en: I have guarded the Bulwark's door too long.
Water drips inside the wall, on and on.
Moss still grows in this radon haze.
Monsters are getting bolder lately.

lines.zh: 壁垒门口的牌子，我每天都擦。
lines.en: I wipe the Bulwark's sign every day.

lines.zh: 氡气烧不到我，我守着壁垒。
lines.en: Radon can't burn me; I guard the bulwark.

lines.zh: 氡气伤不到我，我就在这儿站着。
lines.en: Radon cannot hurt me; here I stand.

lines.zh: 战利品清单，好像少记一件。
lines.en: The loot ledger seems one entry short.

lines.zh: 这云看着要下雨，墙得看紧。
lines.en: These clouds mean rain; the wall needs watching.

lines.zh: 壁垒的氡气里，我站了很久。
lines.en: I have stood long in the Bulwark's radon.

lines.zh: 壁垒地牢里没有菜，只有氡。
lines.en: No garden in the Bulwark. Only radon.

lines.zh: 你走路一点声音都没有。
lines.en: Your steps make no sound at all.
Where do you come from?

lines.zh: 你的靴底沾着地牢的灰。
lines.en: Dungeon dust clings to your soles.

lines.zh: 说快些，我还要去查闸门。
lines.en: Be quick — I still have gates to check.

lines.zh: 没见过的脸，从哪道门进来？
lines.en: An unfamiliar face — which gate did you come through?

lines.zh: 又一个来地牢里翻东西的。
lines.en: Another one come to rummage the dungeon.

lines.zh: 壁垒地牢里，氡气伤不到我。
lines.en: In the Bulwark, radon can't hurt me.
What do you need, guest?

lines.zh: 你吸了太多氡，脸都白了。
lines.en: You've breathed too much radon — you've gone pale.
Radon does nothing to me, do not hope.
The radon reek is thick; stand back.

lines.zh: 氡气对我没用，对你可不一样。
lines.en: Radon does nothing to me. You are another matter.
I keep the gate of the Bulwark dungeon.

lines.zh: 别碰壁垒的藏品，会沾氡。
lines.en: Don't touch the bulwark's relics — they're radon-tainted.

lines.zh: 来个人，替我守住这道门。
lines.en: Someone come hold this door for me.

lines.zh: 氡气护着我，可这一下真疼。
lines.en: The radon shields me, but that one hurt.
A guard is down — ring the alarm!
Oh, my poor back!
The lead lining holds — I can still stand.

lines.zh: 护甲裂了，氡从缝里漏出去。
lines.en: My plate cracked — radon leaks from the seam.

lines.zh: 氡护甲挡不住钝击，你知道吗？
lines.en: Radon plate doesn't stop blunt force — did you know?
A thief is heading for the rift vault!
Stop knocking my plate with that pick!
The Bulwark dungeon wall cracked.
Radiation can't hurt me. The book can.

lines.zh: 那矿石的颜色，像氡的绿光。
lines.en: That ore glows the green of radon.
I smell fresh bread.

lines.zh: 比我护甲上的旧铅衬好。
lines.en: Better than the old lead lining on my plate.
Selling those carrots?
Radon seeps in the cracks; I can't sleep.
I know the glint of an emerald.
Spare me a chunk of radon stone.
Radon does not rot this shell.
That bread smells great.
Step aside — I'm through the gate.
You knocked my mask askew.

lines.zh: 撞在我这身铅衬护甲上。
lines.en: You bumped my lead-lined plate.
Sorry, this radon armor is clumsy.
I keep the Bulwark's stone gate.
Nearly knocked me over.

lines.zh: 氡气伤不到我，也护着门。
lines.en: Radon cannot hurt me, and I guard the door.

lines.zh: 壁垒地牢的氡，伤不了我。
lines.en: The radon in the Bulwark can't hurt me.
What's the rush? The dungeon isn't going anywhere.
You've stepped on my patrol line.
Don't be shy, I'm honest.
Radon can't rot this body of mine.
Shall we watch the sunset?

lines.zh: 今晚地牢的石缝里有月光。
lines.en: Moonlight falls through the dungeon's cracks tonight.
The bulwark's stone roof fits us both.
First, fix the lead door of the watchpost.
I want to share many night watches with you.

lines.zh: 守了这么多年，我只信你。
lines.en: After all these years guarding, I trust only you.
Your fields are well kept.
In the radon haze, we lean close.
I take a little of the dungeon's gold.
This lead plate can still patch armor.

lines.zh: 这骨头上有啃过的痕迹。
lines.en: There are gnaw marks on this bone.

lines.zh: 壁垒里的东西，归我收着。
lines.en: What's in the bulwark, I keep.

lines.zh: 掉在巡逻道上的，归守卫。
lines.en: What falls on the patrol path belongs to the guard.
Is this worth anything?

lines.zh: 这块带氡的矿石，我先捡。
lines.en: I spotted this radon-laced ore first.
I'll tuck it into my armor's lining.
Who lost this bread?
An emerald, for me!
Hands off my stall!
An attacker, look out!
Stay calm, everyone calm.

lines.zh: 壁垒里的氡气，对我无效。
lines.en: The radon in the Bulwark doesn't affect me.
You've stepped into my patrol sector.
Shut the lead door of the radon chamber!

lines.zh: 氡从地砖缝里冒出来，别吸。
lines.en: Radon seeps from the floor cracks. Don't breathe it.
I'm armed, you know.
Everyone, get inside!
The gate clanged — someone's broken in.

lines.zh: 氡气伤不了我，但你别偷。
lines.en: Radon can't hurt me — but you don't steal.
Raise the torch higher.
There. Radon is seeping in.
Only I watch this dungeon door.
No exit behind the radon walls.
I watch the Bulwark dungeon door.
Hold on, I'm coming.

lines.zh: 堵住通往裂隙水晶的走廊！
lines.en: Block the corridor to the rift crystals!

lines.zh: 这地方的味道，我记了很多年。
lines.en: I've remembered this place's smell for years.
I hug the wall and circle behind you.
My gauntlet grazed your shoulder.

lines.zh: 离开壁垒，这里不欢迎你。
lines.en: Leave the bulwark — you're not welcome.
Don't come closer.
You ducked my horizontal swing.
The bulwark's walls move slower than me.

lines.zh: 氡气在身边，我照样不让。
lines.en: Radon all around me, and I still refuse.
One crosscut, then another.
Take my hoe!
Taste the radon dust on my gauntlet!
Hit its legs!
In the Bulwark, the door is still locked.
Any customers today?
The lamp by the door is lit.
I keep the Bulwark dungeon door.

lines.zh: 氡气伤不到我，我守在这。
lines.en: Radon can't hurt me — I stand guard here.

lines.zh: 壁垒的岗哨，今天由我当值。
lines.en: I stand watch at the bulwark today.
The gate's lock has been pried open.
Open the window first.

lines.zh: 我该在岗亭里，怎么到了这儿。
lines.en: I should be in the watchpost — how am I here?

lines.zh: 我叫 Radon Sentinel，做买卖的。
lines.en: I'm Radon Sentinel, a trader.
Hot, hot, hot!
A radon pit opened in the patrol path.

lines.zh: 地牢下层的水，冷得刺骨。
lines.en: The water in the lower dungeon is bone-cold.

lines.zh: 爆炸震落了顶上的碎石。
lines.en: The blast shook loose stones from the ceiling.

lines.zh: 氡气对我无效，对你可不是。
lines.en: Radon does nothing to me, not to you.
I've guarded this dungeon a long while.

lines.zh: 守了三天，一口干粮没吃。
lines.en: Three days on watch, not a bite.

lines.zh: 末地的雷，也劈不穿这地牢。
lines.en: Even End lightning can't crack this dungeon.

lines.zh: 氡气托不住我，虚空也一样。
lines.en: Radon will not hold me, and neither will the void.
